payload.gloss: the whole state of the entity as of this record; never a delta. A concept's payload is its anchor, gloss and factors; a plan's is its name, the concepts it realizes and its lifecycle state; a unit's is its plan, full spec and lifecycle state; a note's is its title, kind, topic, body and whatever it blocks.
